chunks: He said: 'O Lord, I called my people night and day,'
ai.seo_question: What was Prophet Noah's method of calling his people to God according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Nuh (71:5) underscores the Prophet's exhaustive da'wah strategy, reflecting the concept of 'istidraj' where prolonged patience precedes divine decree. It highlights the transition from private, nocturnal appeals to public, daytime declarations, illustrating the comprehensive nature of his mission before the final verdict of the flood.
